name: @mondarth/emma-module
description: EMMA - Enhanced Module Manager Application, the Foundry VTT module.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.e2e:server: mkdir -p tests/e2e/.data/Data/modules/mondarth-emma && HOST_UID=$(id -u) HOST_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f tests/e2e/compose.yaml up --detach --wait --force-recreate
